arxiv-1610-01470.title: Linear Combinations of Unordered Data Vectors
arxiv-1610-01470.creator: Piotr Hofman, Jérôme Leroux, Patrick Totzke
arxiv-1610-01470.description: Abstract Data vectors generalise finite multisets: they are finitely supported functions into a commutative monoid. We study the question if a given data vector can be expressed as a finite sum of others, only assuming that 1) the domain is countable and 2) the given set of base vectors is finite up to permutations of the domain.

arxiv-2110-02002.title: Unidirectional modes induced by nontraditional Coriolis force in stratified fluids
arxiv-2110-02002.creator: Nicolas Perez, Pierre Delplace, Antoine Venaille
arxiv-2110-02002.description: Abstract Using topology, we unveil the existence of new unidirectional modes in compressible rotating stratified fluids. We relate their emergence to the breaking of time-reversal symmetry by rotation and vertical mirror symmetry by stratification and gravity. We stress the role of the Coriolis force’s nontraditional part, induced by a rotation field tangent to the surface.

arxiv-2112-05131.title: Plenoxels: Radiance Fields without Neural Networks
arxiv-2112-05131.creator: Alex Yu, Sara Fridovich-KeilMatthew TancikQinhong ChenBenjamin RechtAngjoo Kanazawa UC Berkeley
arxiv-2112-05131.description: Abstract We introduce Plenoxels (plenoptic voxels), a system for photorealistic view synthesis. Plenoxels represent a scene as a sparse 3D grid with spherical harmonics. This representation can be optimized from calibrated images via gradient methods and regularization without any neural components.

arxiv-2207-14316.creator: Kaitlyn Shin, Kiyoshi W. Masui, Mohit Bhardwaj, Tomas Cassanelli, Pragya Chawla, Matt Dobbs, Fengqiu Adam Dong, Emmanuel Fonseca, B. M. arxiv-2207-14316.description: Abstract Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are brief, energetic, typically extragalactic flashes of radio emission whose progenitors are largely unknown. Although studying the FRB population is essential for understanding how these astrophysical phenomena occur, such studies have been difficult to conduct without large numbers of FRBs and characterizable observational biases.

arxiv-2404-02105.title: Individual-Ion Addressing and Readout in a Penning Trap
arxiv-2404-02105.creator: Brian J. McMahon, Kenton R. Brown, Creston D. Herold, Brian C. Sawyer
arxiv-2404-02105.description: Abstract We implement individual addressing and readout of ions in a rigidly rotating planar crystal in a compact, permanent magnet Penning trap. The crystal of Ca + 40 {}^{40}\text{Ca}^{+} is trapped and stabilized without defects via a rotating triangular potential. The trapped ion fluorescence is detected in the rotating frame for parallel readout.

pmc-11317143.title: Loops are geometric catalysts for DNA integration
pmc-11317143.creator: Cleis Battaglia, Davide Michieletto
pmc-11317143.description: The insertion of DNA elements within genomes underpins both genetic diversity and disease when unregulated. Most of DNA insertions are not random and the physical mechanisms underlying the integration site selection are poorly understood. Here, we perform Molecular Dynamics simulations to study the insertion of DNA elements, such as viral DNA or transposons, into naked DNA or chromatin substrates.

pmc-11405699.title: Leiomodin 2 neonatal dilated cardiomyopathy mutation results in altered actin gene signatures and cardiomyocyte dysfunction
pmc-11405699.creator: Jessika B. Iwanski, Christopher T. Pappas, Rachel M. Mayfield, Gerrie P. Farman, Rebecca Ahrens-Nicklas, Jared M. Churko, Carol C. Gregorio
pmc-11405699.description: Neonatal dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a poorly understood muscular disease of the heart. Several homozygous biallelic variants in LMOD2, the gene encoding the actin-binding protein Leiomodin 2, have been identified to result in severe DCM. Collectively, LMOD2-related cardiomyopathies present with cardiac dilation and decreased heart contractility, often resulting in neonatal death.

pmc-12469478.title: The Healing Environment for Healthcare Staff in Paediatric Settings: A Cross-National Semi-Structured Survey on Healthcare Staff Satisfaction
pmc-12469478.creator: Silvia Mangili, Beatrice Pattaro, Andrea Brambilla, Gaia Ferraguzzi, Cristiana Caira, Stefano Capolongo
pmc-12469478.description: Background: The existing literature emphasises that the hospital environment plays a critical role in the experiences of patients and healthcare workers. To better understand the perspectives of healthcare staff in such settings, a questionnaire-based study was conducted at two paediatric hospitals: Vittore Buzzi Hospital (Milan, Italy) and Queen Silvia Children’s Hospital (Gothenburg, Sweden).

pmc-12552398.title: Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring in surgery for intramedullary spinal cord lesions – workflow, setup and outcomes
pmc-12552398.creator: Henrik Frisk, Gayane Margaryan, Ali Buwaider, Davit Sargsyan, Victor Gabriel El-Hajj, Tomas Majing, Aman Singh, Alexander Fletcher-Sandersjöö, Oscar Persson, Victor E Staartjes, Jonas K E Persson, Erik Edström, Adrian Elmi-Terander
pmc-12552398.description: ObjectiveGross total resection is strived for in intramedullary spinal cord lesion surgery. Intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring (IONM) is the gold standard, but there is no consensus on the optimal IONM workflow. This study details our institutional workflow.MethodsWe retrospectively reviewed all adults who underwent intramedullary resection at Karolinska University Hospital, 2007–2021 (n = 70).

pmc-12602912.title: Prognostic significance of HER2-low and HER2-zero status before and after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with HER2-negative breast cancer
pmc-12602912.creator: Youzhao Ma, Jingyang Zhang, Lina Wang, Dechuang Jiao, Xiuchun Chen, Zhenzhen Liu
pmc-12602912.description: Background:Changes in human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status following neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) indicate tumor heterogeneity.Objective:Investigating the prognostic impact of the transition between HER2-low and HER2-zero may help eliminate the confounding effects of heterogeneity, thereby clarifying the prognostic significance of HER2-low status.Design:Retrospective analysis.

pmc-12999579.creator: Ke Song, Hongrui Zhang, Haoqi Liu, Yuanyuan Li, Yikun Sun, Xinglu Dong, Chenxi Tao, Yannan He, Zhenhong Liu, Yonghong Gao, Ying Gao
pmc-12999579.description: BackgroundNaoshuantong capsule (NST), a Traditional Chinese Medicine formulation, is used for ischemic stroke treatment; however, its molecular mechanisms are unclear. pmc-13157763.title: Medication errors in practice: A mixed-methods study from Diwan Polyclinic-Muscat
pmc-13157763.creator: Zainab Ali Mohammed Al-Mukhaini, Ingrid Passarin, Edna M. Mora Palomares
pmc-13157763.description: ObjectiveTo explore healthcare professionals’ experiences with medication errors (MEs) in terms of types and factors that contribute to them.DesignA mixed-methods study was conducted to explore the MEs experiences of healthcare professionals. Quantitative data were collected through a cross-sectional, self-administered questionnaire, whereas qualitative data were collected via face-to-face semi-structured interviews.

pmc-13321540.description: BackgroundTimely and adequate bereavement support is associated with better mental health and psychosocial outcomes for bereaved individuals.
